QuickTeam helps US businesses grow by placing high-quality offshore talent — trained, vetted, and ready to work — at a fraction of the cost of hiring locally. We handle recruiting, onboarding, and client support from end to end. We're growing fast and looking for closers who want to be paid for what they actually produce. How this is different?

Most commission roles pay you once per deal and move on. This one keeps paying. Every month a client's virtual assistant is working, you earn. Close a client once, and that account generates income for as long as the VA stays — and our VAs typically stay for years. You're also not starting from scratch.

We have a dedicated lead specialist who continuously researches, qualifies, and contextualizes leads for you, so you're always working a warm pipeline. Your job is to close, not to build a list. What you get Warm, contextualized leads — a dedicated member of our team constantly builds and prepares your pipeline. You come in warm, not cold.

Recurring income — your commission is tied to hours billed by the VAs you place. Active placements mean monthly income, month after month, with no additional effort on your part. Long-term compounding upside — clients who stay for two or three years keep paying you the whole time. Your book of business grows and compounds.

Uncapped earnings in USD — no territory limits, no income ceiling. Full tools and access — CRM, dialer, email, and everything you need to work deals effectively. Backend handled for you — we manage recruiting, onboarding, and ongoing client delivery so you stay focused on selling.

What earnings look like Because commission is tied to hours worked rather than a flat placement fee, income compounds as your book grows. A modest base of a few active long-term clients generates meaningful recurring monthly income in USD — and that base keeps building as you close more.

The commission structure is competitive and discussed in full during the interview. How it works You apply and we walk you through the model, the leads, and the comp. We get you set up with tools and access. You start working leads and closing deals. You get paid — and keep getting paid every month your clients stay active.

Requirements What we're looking for Proven B2B sales or closing experience — staffing, services, SaaS, or similar preferred Exceptional spoken English is non-negotiable. This role is 100% phone-based selling to US business owners and decision makers.

Your voice, clarity, and confidence on a cold call is your product — if a prospect would hesitate for even a moment based on how you sound, this isn't the right fit. Candidates with a neutral, natural-sounding English accent are strongly preferred.

Who we are ⬇️
Thinkific is an award-winning learning commerce platform built for scale. By bringing together community, courses, and content with commerce, we power transformative learning experiences and give businesses everything they need to grow their revenue— all from one AI-powered platform.
We’re a team of 300+ Thinkers building products that matter. Every role at Thinkific contributes to raising the bar for online learning, supporting thousands of learning businesses, and creating real-world impact for millions of learners around the world. You’ll work alongside curious, collaborative teammates who care deeply about what they build and who they build it for.
We’re committed to a fair, inclusive, and human hiring experience. Our team is here to guide you every step of the way, so you always know what to expect!

Are you an ambitious relationship builder who thrives on connecting with people and creating new opportunities?
We're looking for a Sales Development Representative to join our growing sales team as a high-impact, all-bound pipeline driver. This isn't a siloed inbound or outbound role — you'll own both, working the full top of funnel with equal fluency. You'll be the first impression Thinkific makes on prospective customers, and you'll be expected to operate like a modern, AI-native seller: smart targeting, sharp messaging, fast execution.
You'll work closely with our Account Executive team and marketing to help build a qualified pipeline, run signal-based outbound plays, and ensure no inbound lead goes unworked. You'll be expected to use AI tools not as a shortcut, but as a force multiplier — doing more, personalizing better, and moving faster than a traditional SDR.

Own inbound lead qualification: respond fast, qualify rigorously, and book quality meetings for our AE team
Build and execute outbound sequences targeting our ICP, using Clay, Gong, Sales Navigator, and AI-driven research to personalize at scale
Run signal-based prospecting using buying triggers (hiring activity, tech stack changes, funding events, content engagement) to prioritize outreach
Execute multi-channel sequences across email, phone, LinkedIn, etc.
Partner with AEs to align on target accounts, messaging, and pipeline goals
Hit and exceed monthly goals
Continuously test and iterate messaging; bring a hypothesis-driven mindset to what's working and why

1-2 years of SDR/BDR experience in B2B SaaS (bonus points for learning tech, HR tech, or an adjacent space)
Demonstrated ability to self-source pipeline through outbound, not just work inbound queues
Hands-on experience with AI-powered sales tools like Clay, Apollo,Gong etc; you should be able to show us your workflow, not just list the tools you’ve used
Proficiency with Salesforce (or equivalent CRM) and a sequencing tool (Outreach, Salesloft, or Gong)
Strong written communication, your emails sound like you, and your cold calls don't sound like scripts
Genuine curiosity about prospects' businesses and a knack for asking questions that uncover real pain
High accountability: you track your own numbers, know where you stand against goal, and proactively close gaps
Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment
